entries.title: Psalms 65:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song.>> Praise is awaiting You, O God, in Zion; And to You the vow shall be performed.

entries.title: Psalms 65:2
segments: O You who hear prayer, To You all flesh will come.

entries.title: Psalms 65:3
segments: Iniquities prevail against me; [As for] our transgressions, You will provide atonement for them.

entries.title: Psalms 65:4
segments: Blessed [is the man] You choose, And cause to approach [You, That] he may dwell in Your courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, Of Your holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 65:5
segments: [By] awesome deeds in righteousness You will answer us, O God of our salvation, [You who are] the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of the far-off seas;

entries.title: Psalms 65:6
segments: ¶Who established the mountains by His strength, [Being] clothed with power;

entries.title: Psalms 65:7
segments: You who still the noise of the seas, The noise of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 65:8
segments: They also who dwell in the farthest parts are afraid of Your signs; You make the outgoings of the morning and evening rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 65:9
segments: You visit the earth and water it, You greatly enrich it; The river of God is full of water; You provide their grain, For so You have prepared it.

entries.title: Psalms 65:10
segments: You water its ridges abundantly, You settle its furrows; You make it soft with showers, You bless its growth.

entries.title: Psalms 65:11
segments: You crown the year with Your goodness, And Your paths drip [with] abundance.

entries.title: Psalms 65:12
segments: They drop [on] the pastures of the wilderness, And the little hills rejoice on every side.

entries.title: Psalms 65:13
segments: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.
